messages.text: hey can u help me make a grocery list for the week? trying to hit the saturday farmers market for veggies
Sure, let's build it around what you get Saturday.
also remind me to grab oat milk, i need my iced oat milk coffee in the morning or im useless lol
Got it, oat milk is on the list.
kids have school lunch stuff too, theyre so picky ugh
I'll add some kid-friendly lunch options.
need an easy pasta idea for friday, kids want pasta on fridays its like a rule now
Cute tradition, how about penne with butter and parmesan?
yeah that works, maybe with peas on the side
Perfect, I'll save that for Friday.
also tuesdays are crazy cuz kids have soccer in the evening so need something super quick for dinner tues
Okay, I'll keep Tuesday dinners quick and simple.
ugh need to book dentist for me and the kids, can u find morning appointments? i prefer mornings
Mornings are best, I'll look for early slots.
afternoons im at school counseling stuff so yeah mornings only
Understood, filtering for morning times.
lmk what u find, gotta run to work
Will do, have a good day at work.
my mom rosa is coming over sunday, need a dessert idea
What kind of sweets does she like?
she loves anything lemon so maybe lemon bars? can u send a simple recipe
Lemon bars are perfect, I'll find an easy recipe.
shes been helping with the kids a lot lately
That's sweet of her.
trying a dairy-free trial until nov 22 so need dinner ideas with no cheese/milk this week
Got it, I'll keep everything dairy-free for now.
kids are gonna complain lol but we'll try
We'll find some kid-approved ones.
also whats the weather tmrw? we usually do an evening walk around the block after dinner
I'll check tomorrow's weather for your walk.
heading to the saturday farmers market in a bit, what should i get for tacos?
Grab tomatoes, onions, cilantro and limes.
cool, hope they have good avocados today
Fingers crossed for ripe ones.
parking there is always a nightmare haha
Go early if you can.
ok friday pasta time, kids want pasta on fridays so what sauce besides red?
Try garlic olive oil with broccoli.
my 8 yr old hates broccoli tho
Then maybe just garlic bread and plain pasta.
lol true, keep it simple
Simple always wins on Fridays.
ugh kids soccer moved from tue to thu evenings so need to replan dinners
Oh no, schedule changes are tough.
yeah so thursday dinner must be quick now cuz of soccer practice
Got it, I'll make Thursdays the quick dinner night.
and dont do the old one anymore, tuesdays are free now no need for quick tues dinner
Understood, quick dinners moved to Thursday.
also need my iced oat milk coffee recipe, mine tasted watery today
Try less ice and a double shot.
need to schedule parent teacher conference for my 11 yr old, do u know if they have morning appointments? i prefer mornings
I can check for morning availability.
i can do before 9am dropoff kinda thing
Perfect, I'll note before 9am.
school counselor life but still hate afternoon meetings lol
Makes sense with your work schedule.
looking for bday gift for my mom rosa, she loves mystery novels right? any recs
Yes, I can suggest some cozy mysteries.
oh also want to bake her lemon cake cuz she loves lemon desserts, need a dairy free version tho
I'll find a dairy-free lemon cake recipe.
shes the best, watches kids when i have late meetings
She sounds wonderful.
is it gonna rain tonight? we do our evening walk around the block after dinner if its clear
Let me check tonight's forecast.
kids need to burn energy after thu soccer lol
A walk sounds perfect after practice.
btw been stressed, got custody paperwork in progress with their dad so trying to keep routines normal
That sounds stressful, keeping routines helps.
can u give me dairy free breakfast ideas? still on that dairy-free trial until nov 22
How about oatmeal with fruit and peanut butter?
my 8 yr old will only eat cereal ugh
There are good dairy-free cereals with oat milk.
true, we have cheerios at home
Perfect, that works great.
my iced oat milk coffee craving is real today, any new cafe near me in miami?
I'll look up cafes with oat milk nearby.
need decaf after 2pm or i wont sleep lol
Good call, decaf in the afternoon.
omg finally bought concert tickets for next month, just me and a friend, one-time treat!
So fun, enjoy your night out!
planning meals around what i got at the saturday farmers market last week, lots of squash left
Squash soup could be great.
yeah need dairy free soup recipe
I'll find a dairy-free squash soup.
going again this saturday hopefully
Nice, hope you find good stuff.
friday tomorrow, kids want pasta on fridays so need to shop tonight
Want me to add pasta to your list?.
yes pls, and thursday was hectic with soccer so glad friday is chill
Thursdays sound busy now.
also mom rosa is coming for dinner, making lemon chicken cuz she loves lemon desserts and lemon anything lol
Lemon chicken sounds perfect for Rosa.
she always brings crosswords for the kids
That's such a cute habit.
need to book my annual physical, can u call out morning appointments only? i prefer mornings for any doctor stuff
Absolutely, I'll filter for mornings.
miami traffic is awful after 10am
Morning avoids the worst traffic.
then evening walk around the block after dinner to unwind, if kids cooperate lol
Hope you get a nice relaxing walk.

_label: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA, held out. Persona Sofia, 41, Miami. School counselor, single mom of kids aged 8 and 11.
